format:
  html:
    css: invest_styles.css
---
::: {.column-screen}
```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Investment Growth Calculator</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS for styling -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- Chart.js for plotting -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
    <style>
        /* Custom styles for better aesthetics */
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        .card {
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }
        .btn-primary {
            background-color: #3b82f6;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 0.5rem;
            transition: background-color 0.2s;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            background-color: #2563eb;
        }
        input[type="number"], select {
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
            border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
            width: 100%;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8">

    <div class="mx-auto">
        <div class="text-center mb-8">
            <h1 class="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-800">Investment Calculator</h1>
            <p class="text-lg text-gray-600 mt-2">A First Pass at Retirement Planning</p>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
            <!-- Input Controls Column -->
            <div class="lg:col-span-1">
                <div class="card space-y-4">
                    <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-700">Financial Inputs</h2>
                    
                    <div>
                        <label for="initial_investment" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Initial Investment ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="initial_investment" value="10000" min="0" class="mt-1">
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label for="contribution" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Contribution per Paycheck ($)</label>
                        <input type="number" id="contribution" value="500" min="0" class="mt-1">
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label for="pay_frequency" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Pay Frequency</label>
                        <select id="pay_frequency" class="mt-1">
                            <option value="52">Weekly</option>
                            <option value="26" selected>Bi-weekly</option>
                            <option value="24">Semi-monthly</option>
                            <option value="12">Monthly</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                        <label for="years" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Investment Duration (Years): <span id="years-label" class="font-bold">20</span></label>
                        <input type="range" id="years" min="1" max="50" value="20" class="w-full h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer mt-1">
                    </div>

                    <hr class="my-4">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-700">Scenario Rates of Return</h3>

                    <div>
                        <label for="bear_rate" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Bear Case (%): <span id="bear-rate-label" class="font-bold text-red-600">4.0</span></label>
                        <input type="range" id="bear_rate" min="0" max="20" value="4" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-red-100 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer mt-1">
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                        <label for="base_rate" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Base Case (%): <span id="base-rate-label" class="font-bold text-blue-600">7.0</span></label>
                        <input type="range" id="base_rate" min="0" max="20" value="7" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer mt-1">
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label for="bull_rate" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Bull Case (%): <span id="bull-rate-label" class="font-bold text-green-600">10.0</span></label>
                        <input type="range" id="bull_rate" min="0" max="20" value="10" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-green-100 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer mt-1">
                    </div>

                    <button id="calculate" class="w-full btn-primary mt-4">Calculate Growth</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Output Column -->
            <div class="lg:col-span-3">
                <div class="card">
                    <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Growth Comparison</h2>
                    <div class="w-full h-96">
                        <canvas id="growthChart"></canvas>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="card mt-8">
                     <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Investment Summary</h2>
                     <div id="summaryText" class="text-gray-700">
                        <p>Click "Calculate Growth" to see your projection.</p>
                     </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- DOM Element References ---
        const calculateBtn = document.getElementById('calculate');
        const summaryTextEl = document.getElementById('summaryText');
        const chartCanvas = document.getElementById('growthChart');
        
        // Input elements
        const initialInvestmentEl = document.getElementById('initial_investment');
        const contributionEl = document.getElementById('contribution');
        const payFrequencyEl = document.getElementById('pay_frequency');
        const yearsEl = document.getElementById('years');
        const bearRateEl = document.getElementById('bear_rate');
        const baseRateEl = document.getElementById('base_rate');
        const bullRateEl = document.getElementById('bull_rate');

        // Labels for slider values
        const yearsLabel = document.getElementById('years-label');
        const bearRateLabel = document.getElementById('bear-rate-label');
        const baseRateLabel = document.getElementById('base-rate-label');
        const bullRateLabel = document.getElementById('bull-rate-label');

        let growthChart; // To hold the chart instance

        // --- Core Calculation Logic ---
        function calculateGrowth(initialPrincipal, years, annualRate, periodsPerYear, contribution) {
            const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
            const periodicRate = Math.pow(1 + annualRate, 1 / periodsPerYear) - 1;
            const totalPeriods = years * periodsPerYear;
            
            let balance = initialPrincipal;
            let totalContributions = initialPrincipal;
            let totalReturns = 0;
            
            const timeline = [{ year: currentYear, balance: initialPrincipal }];

            for (let i = 1; i <= totalPeriods; i++) {
                // Standard formula: Calculate returns on the balance BEFORE adding the new contribution.
                const returnsThisPeriod = balance * periodicRate;
                // Add the returns and the new contribution to the balance.
                balance += returnsThisPeriod + contribution;
                
                totalContributions += contribution;
                totalReturns += returnsThisPeriod;

                // Store data point for each year
                if (i % periodsPerYear === 0) {
                    timeline.push({ year: currentYear + (i / periodsPerYear), balance: balance });
                }
            }
             // Ensure the last data point is included
            if (totalPeriods % periodsPerYear !== 0) {
                 timeline.push({ year: currentYear + years, balance: balance });
            }

            return { timeline, final: { balance, totalContributions, totalReturns } };
        }
        
        // --- Chart Rendering Function ---
        function renderChart(bearData, baseData, bullData) {
            const labels = baseData.map(d => d.year);
            
            if (growthChart) {
                growthChart.destroy(); // Destroy old chart before creating a new one
            }

            const ctx = chartCanvas.getContext('2d');
            growthChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: `Bear (${bearRateEl.value}%)`,
                            data: bearData.map(d => d.balance),
                            borderColor: '#ef4444', // Red
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.1
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Base (${baseRateEl.value}%)`,
                            data: baseData.map(d => d.balance),
                            borderColor: '#3b82f6', // Blue
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.1
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Bull (${bullRateEl.value}%)`,
                            data: bullData.map(d => d.balance),
                            borderColor: '#22c55e', // Green
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.1
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: 'Year'
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: 'Portfolio Value'
                            },
                            ticks: {
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return '$' + value.toLocaleString();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    let label = context.dataset.label || '';
                                    if (label) {
                                        label += ': ';
                                    }
                                    if (context.parsed.y !== null) {
                                        label += new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).format(context.parsed.y);
                                    }
                                    return label;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // --- Update Summary Text Function ---
        function updateSummary(bearFinal, baseFinal, bullFinal, years) {
            const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
            
            summaryTextEl.innerHTML = `
                <p class="text-lg mb-4">After <strong>${years} years</strong>, your projected portfolio values are:</p>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <!-- Bear Scenario -->
                    <div class="p-4 bg-red-50 rounded-lg">
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-red-800">Bear Case (${bearRateEl.value}%)</h4>
                        <p class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-red-600 my-2">${formatter.format(bearFinal.balance)}</p>
                        <ul class="text-sm space-y-1 text-gray-600">
                            <li><strong>Contributions:</strong> ${formatter.format(bearFinal.totalContributions)}</li>
                            <li><strong>Returns:</strong> ${formatter.format(bearFinal.totalReturns)}</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                    <!-- Base Scenario -->
                    <div class="p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg">
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-blue-800">Base Case (${baseRateEl.value}%)</h4>
                        <p class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-600 my-2">${formatter.format(baseFinal.balance)}</p>
                        <ul class="text-sm space-y-1 text-gray-600">
                           <li><strong>Contributions:</strong> ${formatter.format(baseFinal.totalContributions)}</li>
                            <li><strong>Returns:</strong> ${formatter.format(baseFinal.totalReturns)}</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                    <!-- Bull Scenario -->
                    <div class="p-4 bg-green-50 rounded-lg">
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-green-800">Bull Case (${bullRateEl.value}%)</h4>
                        <p class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-green-600 my-2">${formatter.format(bullFinal.balance)}</p>
                        <ul class="text-sm space-y-1 text-gray-600">
                            <li><strong>Contributions:</strong> ${formatter.format(bullFinal.totalContributions)}</li>
                            <li><strong>Returns:</strong> ${formatter.format(bullFinal.totalReturns)}</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        // --- Main Handler Function ---
        function handleCalculation() {
            // Get values from inputs
            const initial = parseFloat(initialInvestmentEl.value);
            const contrib = parseFloat(contributionEl.value);
            const freq = parseInt(payFrequencyEl.value);
            const yrs = parseInt(yearsEl.value);
            const rateBear = parseFloat(bearRateEl.value) / 100;
            const rateBase = parseFloat(baseRateEl.value) / 100;
            const rateBull = parseFloat(bullRateEl.value) / 100;

            // Perform calculations
            const bearResult = calculateGrowth(initial, yrs, rateBear, freq, contrib);
            const baseResult = calculateGrowth(initial, yrs, rateBase, freq, contrib);
            const bullResult = calculateGrowth(initial, yrs, rateBull, freq, contrib);

            // Update UI
            renderChart(bearResult.timeline, baseResult.timeline, bullResult.timeline);
            updateSummary(bearResult.final, baseResult.final, bullResult.final, yrs);
        }

        // --- Event Listeners ---
        calculateBtn.addEventListener('click', handleCalculation);
        
        // Update slider labels on input
        yearsEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => yearsLabel.textContent = e.target.value);
        bearRateEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => bearRateLabel.textContent = parseFloat(e.target.value).toFixed(1));
        baseRateEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => baseRateLabel.textContent = parseFloat(e.target.value).toFixed(1));
        bullRateEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => bullRateLabel.textContent = parseFloat(e.target.value).toFixed(1));

        // --- Initial Calculation on Page Load ---
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', handleCalculation);

    </script>
</body>
</html>

```
:::
